TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniafamily_family
TABLE.COMMENT: One household: its adults and its children

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: active or closed

FIELD.NAME: source
FIELD.COMMENT: Where it came from: manual, claim, csv, cifra, oneroster

FIELD.NAME: sourcekey
FIELD.COMMENT: The household in its source, if it has one

FIELD.NAME: timeclosed
FIELD.COMMENT: When it was closed, for the retention of its data

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniafamily_adult
TABLE.COMMENT: An adult of a household, with or without a Moodle account

FIELD.NAME: phone
FIELD.COMMENT: In E.164 form

FIELD.NAME: phoneverified
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the phone is known to be theirs: from the school or WhatsApp, not just typed

FIELD.NAME: sourcekey
FIELD.COMMENT: The adult in its source, such as cifra:123 or oneroster:abc

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The adult's Moodle account, if any

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: active or left

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniafamily_child
TABLE.COMMENT: A child of a household: a student, with a Moodle account or a key in the school's data

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student's Moodle account, if any

FIELD.NAME: sourcekey
FIELD.COMMENT: The student in the school's data, such as cifra:123 or oneroster:abc

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: active or left

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniafamily_claim
TABLE.COMMENT: A code that a family claims to join a student

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student

FIELD.NAME: codehash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the code; the code itself is never stored

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: active or revoked

FIELD.NAME: claims
FIELD.COMMENT: How many adults claimed it

FIELD.NAME: usermodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Who issued it

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniafamily_request
TABLE.COMMENT: A request for consent that the school sends to the families of some students

FIELD.NAME: contextid
FIELD.COMMENT: Where it was made: a course or the site

FIELD.NAME: deadline
FIELD.COMMENT: The last second families can answer

FIELD.NAME: scope
FIELD.COMMENT: Who it went to: course, group or cohort; empty for students one by one

FIELD.NAME: scopeid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course, group or cohort

FIELD.NAME: needall
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 if every adult of a student has to say yes; 0 if one is enough

FIELD.NAME: keepdays
FIELD.COMMENT: Days after the deadline before it is erased with its answers

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: open or cancelled

FIELD.NAME: timereminded
FIELD.COMMENT: When the reminder of the day before went out

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniafamily_target
TABLE.COMMENT: The students a request is about

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniafamily_answer
TABLE.COMMENT: Each answer to a request, never changed: a new answer is a new row, so the history is the record

FIELD.NAME: childuserid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student

FIELD.NAME: adultid
FIELD.COMMENT: The adult of the family records; 0 for a paper answer from someone who is not in them

FIELD.NAME: adultname
FIELD.COMMENT: Who answered, as they were called then, so the record outlives the adult

FIELD.NAME: answer
FIELD.COMMENT: yes or no

FIELD.NAME: channel
FIELD.COMMENT: app, web, email, link, whatsapp, telegram or school

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The account that answered, or that wrote down a paper answer

FIELD.NAME: address
FIELD.COMMENT: What it was answered with when there is no account: the e-mail, the number or the chat

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniafamily_photo
TABLE.COMMENT: One photo per student, under their account (user:45) or their key in the school's data; the image is a file of the plugin

FIELD.NAME: photokey
FIELD.COMMENT: user:45, or the student's key in the school's data, such as cifra:123

FIELD.NAME: timeseen
FIELD.COMMENT: The last daily round that found the student still here

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniafamily_standing
TABLE.COMMENT: Standing consents about a student, such as the use of their image: every answer, the last of each adult counts

FIELD.NAME: childkey
FIELD.COMMENT: user:45, or the student's key in the school's data

FIELD.NAME: topic
FIELD.COMMENT: What it is about: image

FIELD.NAME: answer
FIELD.COMMENT: yes or no

FIELD.NAME: adultid
FIELD.COMMENT: The adult of the family who answered; 0 for the school

FIELD.NAME: channel
FIELD.COMMENT: school, web or app

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The account that wrote it down

FIELD.NAME: timeseen
FIELD.COMMENT: The last daily round that found the student still here
